name: alphaosint-jobs
description: Six remote MCP servers for job-market data: LinkedIn Jobs, Google Jobs, Wellfound, Ashby boards, SAP SuccessFactors and isolved career sites. Pay per result on Apify with your own token.

settings.name: Apify API token
settings.description: Your Apify API token from https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations. Each tool call runs an Actor billed to that account; the free plan includes $5 of monthly credit.

linkedin-jobs.description: LinkedIn jobs by keyword and location: title, company, seniority, type, posting date, applicants, salary when shown, full description.

google-jobs.description: Google Jobs listings for a query and location, with highlights and direct apply links.

wellfound-jobs.description: Wellfound (AngelList) startup jobs with salary and equity ranges parsed.

ashby-jobs.description: Openings from any company's Ashby job board, including employer-published salary data.

successfactors-jobs.description: Jobs from SAP SuccessFactors public career sites.

isolved-jobs.description: Jobs from isolved and ApplicantPro career sites, with tenant discovery.
